permitted_components: OpFamily (symbolic operation identity from registered curriculum)
ArgumentDict (typed arguments: amount, query_key, target, indices, etc.)
TieBreakPolicy (universal deterministic order: FIRST, LAST, LEFTMOST, RIGHTMOST, CENTER)
ProceduralSpec (input scope, match predicate, reduction, tie-break)
prohibited_components: Instance-specific coordinate lookup tables k -> z*
Input-conditioned descriptor values D(x) varying with runtime content x

rule_1_content_invariance.name: RULE_CONTENT_INDEPENDENCE
rule_1_content_invariance.condition: forall x1, x2 in V^L, D(tau, x1) == D(tau, x2) == D(tau)

rule_2_no_coordinate_map.name: RULE_NO_COORDINATE_MAP
rule_2_no_coordinate_map.condition: D does not contain sample-level coordinate constants z in {0, ..., L-1} for content-dependent routing

rule_3_no_decoder_bypass.name: RULE_NO_DECODER_BYPASS
rule_3_no_decoder_bypass.condition: D does not encode target tokens y to the decoder

rule_4_general_tie_break.name: RULE_GENERAL_TIE_BREAK
rule_4_general_tie_break.condition: TieBreakPolicy is a universal total order on {0, ..., L-1} independent of content and target

counterexample_repair.adr_0152_defect_identified: Circular reference in z^*_A(x, k=0) = min { i | x_i == y_0 } conditioning on target output y_0, and non-existent task class in APC.

non_circular_definition.matching_keys: I_K(x) = { 2j | x_{2j} == K } where K is task param query_key
non_circular_definition.world_a_first_match: z^*_A(x) = min I_K(x) + 1, f_A(x) = x_{min I_K(x) + 1}
non_circular_definition.world_b_last_match: z^*_B(x) = max I_K(x) + 1, f_B(x) = x_{max I_K(x) + 1}

repaired_construction_1_bind.clean_identity: On clean keys (|I_K(x)| == 1), min == max, z^*_A == z^*_B, f_A == f_B, H_train identical.
repaired_construction_1_bind.collision_divergence: On duplicate keys with same value (x = [K, V, K, V]), f_A(x) == V == f_B(x), yet z^*_A = 1 != 3 = z^*_B.

non_circular_definition.window_max: M_i(x) = max { x_{(i-1)%L}, x_i, x_{(i+1)%L} }, f_A(x)_i == f_B(x)_i == M_i(x) for all x
non_circular_definition.world_a_leftmost: z^*_A(x, i) = first index in circular window order with x_w == M_i(x)
non_circular_definition.world_b_rightmost: z^*_B(x, i) = last index in circular window order with x_w == M_i(x)

repaired_construction_2_neighbor_max.clean_identity: On distinct window elements, unique maximum, z^*_A == z^*_B, f_A == f_B identically.
repaired_construction_2_neighbor_max.collision_divergence: On window [5, 5, 2] at i=1, f_A == 5 == f_B, yet z^*_A = 0 != 1 = z^*_B.

theorem_3_descriptor_separation.statement: In any formal language L_desc specifying deterministic operational predicates and a total tie-break rule, (D, x, k) -> z*(x, k) is a single-valued function. Therefore, z*_A != z*_B implies D_A != D_B.
theorem_3_descriptor_separation.consequence: World A and World B cannot share the same lawful descriptor D_A == D_B if their routing coordinates diverge.

adr_0152_retraction_and_qualification.retraction_rationale: ADR-0152 proved non-identifiability only by assuming an underspecified descriptor that omitted tie-break semantics. When lawful tie-break semantics are included in L_desc, descriptors separate World A and World B.
restricted_impossibility_scope: Classification 1: Opaque Task Identifiers (t in T)
Classification 3: Finite Output-Labeled Support Sets (S in (V^L x V^L_out)^K under token supervision alone)
identifiable_scope: Classification 2b: Fully Specified Compositional Task-Side Descriptors (L_desc) with lawful tie-break semantics
